<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915043_theRebbe_419" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915043_theRebbe_419__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions why mitzvos must be performed each specific day, given that prayer can refine and elevate mitzvos from adjacent days.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">However, this explanation only explains the connection of mitzvos to days.</t>
    <t s="1">But it is still not understood the necessity of performing the mitzvos specifically each day,</t>
    <t s="2">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="3">even if one misses one day and the next day performs two mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="4">the mitzvos will be refined through the prayer of the following day.</t>
    <t s="5">And one cannot say that prayer can refine and elevate only the mitzvos belonging to that day,</t>
    <t s="6">for there is no reason for this distinction.</t>
    <t s="7">Moreover, since there is the concept of completion</t>
    <t s="8">(on the following day,</t>
    <t s="9">in the prayer adjacent to it)58</t>
    <t s="10">"And we do not say that since its day has passed, its offering is void"59,</t>
    <t s="11">and even that</t>
    <t s="12">(regarding the intention of prayer)</t>
    <t s="13">one prayer gathered from the prayers of the entire year elevates the prayers of the entire year60,</t>
    <t s="14">this implies also regarding the elevation of mitzvos through prayer,</t>
    <t s="15">that prayer elevates even the mitzvos of the adjacent day, etc.</t>
    <t s="16">And a support for this matter – the prayers of Shabbos, which elevate the prayers of all the weekdays along with all the Torah and good deeds included in them61.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the purpose of mitzvos is to refine the physical world, including time itself, necessitating a mitzvah each day.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">But the matter is,</t>
    <t s="2">behold it is known that the purpose of Torah and mitzvos is to effect clarification and refinement in this physical world.</t>
    <t s="3">For this is what "Torah is not in heaven"62 means,</t>
    <t s="4">and all Torah was given to make peace in the world63,</t>
    <t s="5">and all the more so mitzvos, which were only given to refine the creations through them64.</t>
    <t s="6">And even the mitzvah of tzedakah is equivalent to all the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="7">(and is called by the name "mitzvah" in general),</t>
    <t s="8">for the purpose of mitzvos</t>
    <t s="9">[and likewise the purpose of the soul's descent below]</t>
    <t s="10">which is</t>
    <t s="11">[not for the sake of the soul, but rather]</t>
    <t s="12">in order to rectify the body and the Nefesh HaBahamis and its portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="13">is completed through the mitzvah of tzedakah</t>
    <t s="14">(more so than through all other mitzvos),</t>
    <t s="15">as explained in Tanya65.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is66</t>
    <t s="17">that there must be specifically complete days,</t>
    <t s="18">that on each and every day there must be the fulfillment of a mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="19">for since the definition of the world is place and time67,</t>
    <t s="20">behold it is understood that Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="21">(whose purpose is to rectify the world)</t>
    <t s="22">must also rectify time.</t>
    <t s="23">Therefore it is necessary that on every day there be the performance of a mitzvah</t>
    <t s="24">(even though when one misses one day he can make the garment by fulfilling two mitzvos tomorrow),</t>
    <t s="25">for in order to rectify the days68</t>
    <t s="26">(time)</t>
    <t s="27">itself, it is necessary that each69</t>
    <t s="28">and every day do its work.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "Avraham was old, coming in days" refers to the superior level of rectifying time itself, completing the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower worlds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is "And Avraham was old, coming in days",</t>
    <t s="2">that after "Avraham was old" he is also "coming in days," which is a greater level even than the level of "old."</t>
    <t s="3">For behold, the true intention in the creation of the worlds</t>
    <t s="4">(in the aspect of Atzmus Ein Sof)</t>
    <t s="5">is that which the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place specifically in the lower realms70.</t>
    <t s="6">And this intention is completed through the service of man,</t>
    <t s="7">"You are called 'man'"71,</t>
    <t s="8">that specifically man can complete this intention.</t>
    <t s="9">And this is why he is called by the name "Adam",</t>
    <t s="10">on account of the two extremes: that he is "similar to the upper one"72</t>
    <t s="11">and that he was formed from the earth73,</t>
    <t s="12">that his body was made from the earth itself74</t>
    <t s="13">and in a manner that it was initially inert by itself</t>
    <t s="14">(without any living soul within it)</t>
    <t s="15">and as it is written75</t>
    <t s="16">"Your eyes saw my unformed body"</t>
    <t s="17">(and not like the body of a plant or animal)76,</t>
    <t s="18">for also this matter in the description of "man"</t>
    <t s="19">(on account of the earth)</t>
    <t s="20">indicates his superiority77,</t>
    <t s="21">that he clarifies, rectifies, and elevates even the inert, which is the lowest, below which there is no lower.</t>
    <t s="22">And this level within him is actualized specifically through the service of "coming in days."</t>
    <t s="23">For through the service of "old"</t>
    <t s="24">(itself),</t>
    <t s="25">even though through it he also clarified and rectified his portion in the world</t>
    <t s="26">(place),</t>
    <t s="27">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="28">since he has not yet rectified time,</t>
    <t s="29">behold he has not yet completed the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="30">Therefore, even though this service reaches the aspect of Atik Yomin,</t>
    <t s="31">which is in abstraction</t>
    <t s="32">(and separation)</t>
    <t s="33">from the aspect of days,</t>
    <t s="34">this is not the ultimate perfection.</t>
    <t s="35">However, through the service of "coming in days"78,</t>
    <t s="36">when one works to rectify the days,</t>
    <t s="37">and even to the extent of "and I will fill the number of your days"79</t>
    <t s="38">"number" from the term "sapphire stone"</t>
    <t s="39">(and as explained in Torah Ohr80</t>
    <t s="40">that "the number of your days" is like "the heavens declare"81</t>
    <t s="41">which the Zohar82 interprets</t>
    <t s="42">as shining, sparkling, and sapphire-like),</t>
    <t s="43">meaning that man illuminates the days</t>
    <t s="44">(time)</t>
    <t s="45">with the light of Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="46">through this he completes the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms</t>
    <t s="47">(in the lowest of this world itself83),</t>
    <t s="48">and this</t>
    <t s="49">(the completion of this intention)</t>
    <t s="50">is the ultimate perfection of man's level,</t>
    <t s="51">as above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
